## Geometry and neighborhoods

Planned: PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, k-nearest neighbors, k-means, and hierarchical clustering.

## Graphs and optimization

Planned: Louvain, Leiden, dynamic programming, integer linear programming, minimum spanning trees, and neighbor joining.

## Sequence and probabilistic models

Planned: BWT/FM-index, hidden Markov models, MCMC, and Bayesian inference.
